releaseNotes:
1. End-of-Day Z-Report Auto-PDF & 80mm Thermal Slip Preview: Closing a shift now automatically downloads the A4 Z-Report PDF to your Downloads folder, opens an instant 80mm thermal slip preview for printing, and archives all past shifts in the Saved Z-Reports Archive table.
2. Comprehensive Operator Help & User Guide: Full step-by-step interactive manual (/help/index.html) accessible from the Help / Guide menu.
3. India Legal Terms & Hardware License Lock: Built-in India POS Terms & Conditions and cryptographic machine UUID license binding.
